lines.text: A prisoner in the Lord urges believers to walk worthy, with humility, gentleness, and patience, preserving the Spirit's unity.
There is one body, one Spirit, one hope, one Lord, one faith, one baptism, and one God.
Grace is given to each one according to the gift of Christ, who ascended to fill all things.
Christ gave apostles, prophets, evangelists, and pastors and teachers to govern the saints and build up the body of Christ.
Believers mature past infancy, speaking the truth in love and growing up into Christ, who is the hand.
